subject: Next steps: sandbox credentials, rate ceilings, and deployment matrix
messages:
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
To: Priya Singh <priya@novaretail.io>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Mar 2028 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps: sandbox credentials, rate ceilings, and deployment matrix

Hi Priya / Joel —

Thanks again for taking the demo this morning. Quick recap and a suggested path for the evaluation so you can pick the fastest way to validate integration: Hosted API pilot (fastest), Dedicated (predictable throughput), or Private (VPC/on-prem) if you need strict residency.

High-level ask from our side: please confirm whether you want to evaluate Hosted API first or if you need Dedicated/Private scoped for procurement. If Hosted, we can get you a sandbox with endpoints, example keys, and a recommended rate ceiling for the pilot within 48 hours.

What I'm attaching: deployment_matrix.xlsx (simple grid with tradeoffs), sandbox-instructions.pdf (how to call endpoints + sample payloads).

Proposed quickstart for a Hosted pilot (2-week):
- 24-hour sandbox provisioning with two read-only API keys (test and integration)
- Endpoints: /v1/generate and /v1/embeddings (sandbox host + sample base_url in attachment)
- Default rate ceiling: 10 RPS, burst to 20 RPS for 5s (can be tuned once we see traffic)
- Prefill: 1000 test tokens included, sample prompt templates for your search & summarization flows
- Metrics you can expect in the console: per-route latency, token usage, and per-key costs

Security/PII note: Hosted logs are scrubbed by default for trial keys; if you need the sandbox to be completely isolated (no logging), let us know and we'll escalate — that pushes toward Dedicated/Private.

Next steps I need from you:
1) Confirm "Hosted pilot" or "Need Dedicated/Private for pilot"
2) Desired region (us-east / us-west / eu-west) — default is us-east
3) Any required rate ceilings we should pre-configure beyond the default (10 RPS)

If you confirm Hosted, I'll send sandbox credentials + a short runbook and schedule a 30-minute integration sync.

Thanks —

Chloe Martin
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198
Redwood Inference

Attachments: deployment_matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet), sandbox-instructions.pdf (guide)

From: Priya Singh <priya@novaretail.io>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
Cc: Joel Kramer <joel.kramer@novaretail.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Mar 2028 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps: sandbox credentials, rate ceilings, and deployment matrix

Hi Chloe —

Appreciate the clear summary. Two quick clarifications from our side before we pick a path:

1) Data residency: our pilot will use synthetic catalog data, but the program lead asks if hosted logs ever leave the US. We are US-only org for now.
2) Rate ceilings: Joel expects peak bursts around 35 RPS for short windows (search qps). Our traffic shape is spiky during batch imports.

For speed, we prefer to start with Hosted API to validate latency/cost. If we see PII concerns or need stricter controls, we'll explore Dedicated. Could you provision Hosted sandbox in us-west? That's where our primary workloads run.

Also: can you pre-configure a higher burst setting (burst to 40 RPS) for the initial two days? We'll monitor closely and dial back if needed.

Thanks —

Priya Singh
Head of AI Platforms | NovaRetail
priya@novaretail.io

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Priya Singh <priya@novaretail.io>, Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Mar 2028 17:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps: sandbox credentials, rate ceilings, and deployment matrix

Thanks Priya — quick answers from infra/security perspective.

- Hosted logs: by default, sandbox/service logs are stored in Redwood's US datacenters; we can configure region-level retention and strict redaction for trial keys. No logs are exported to third parties. If NovaRetail needs zero-logging for the sandbox, we can enable a no-logs policy for the trial API keys (note: feature flag + short provisioning window).
- Rate ceilings: we can set the sandbox to 10 RPS steady-state with a 40 RPS burst for 10s windows for the first 48 hours; after that we'll evaluate metrics and propose a steady cap. That meets the initial ask.
- Region: provisioning to us-west is fine; latency delta is small.

Operational next steps I propose (internal plan):
1) Chloe sends sandbox keys & runbook (today)
2) I open a temporary higher-burst guardrail on your sandbox keys for the first 48 hours (Monitored by our ops runbook)
3) Marissa will send a short checklist for SOC/Procurement items in case you want to move to Dedicated later

Hi Priya / Joel —

Per Priya's confirmation, we've provisioned a Hosted sandbox in us-west with the requested burst guardrail. Details below and a couple of next steps:

Sandbox access (test keys, read-only for trial):
- Host: https://sandbox.us-west.redwood.ai
- Test key (integration): redwood_sandbox_integration_NR042 (rotating)
- Admin view: https://app.redwood.ai/sandbox/NR-2028-042 (read-only analytics)

Pre-configured rate ceilings:
- Steady: 10 RPS
- Burst: 40 RPS for 10s windows (auto-throttle afterwards)

Links & attachments: deployment_matrix.xlsx (matrix we discussed), sandbox-instructions.pdf (call patterns + sample payloads) — both in the Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1NR-sandbox-docs

Proposed next calls:
- 30-min integration sync to drop the sample SDK into your staging: Monday 3/27 at 10:00 am PT or Tue 3/28 at 11:00 am PT (pick one)
- If the pilot needs a no-logs trial, Marissa will send a brief SOP and cost delta for enabling that option.

Let me know which time works and I'll send a calendar invite. If you want the higher burst extended beyond 48 hours, we'll need a short health check at day 2.

Cheers —

Chloe Martin
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198
